blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson before this one teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: How many photographs do you need to apply for a visa?
exercises.why: «для» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«с» + instrumental singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Сколько яиц в ___ (неделя) сносит эта курица?
exercises.prompt: How many eggs does this hen lay each week?
exercises.why: «в» + accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«из» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Ненависть - это раковая опухоль на ___ (тело) общества.
exercises.prompt: Hate is a cancer on society.
exercises.why: «на» + prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom shoved Mary off the diving board.
exercises.ru: Том столкнул Мэри с ___ для прыжков в воду.
exercises.why: «с» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«к» + dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«в» + prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: She sucks up to the teacher.
exercises.why: «к» + dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«на» + prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The cat is scratching at my door.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom is a widower. He lives at his daughter's place.
exercises.ru: Том - вдовец. Он живёт у своей ___.
exercises.why: «у» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Phenolphthalein is an indicator used in acid-base titrations.
exercises.why: «в» + prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom stood in the corner of the room with a gin and tonic in his hand.
exercises.ru: Том стоял в углу комнаты с джин-тоником в ___.
exercises.why: «в» + prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
